_comment: Manual triage overrides for round-trip failures the stdlib classifier in classify_failures.py cannot route by string patterns alone (they need RDKit canonicalization: @-stereo where atom order also changed, RAW-unparseable aromatics, eta-slot placement on automorphic rings). Molecule -> defect class (must exist in SESSION_OF). classify_failures.py applies these AFTER automatic classification, for failed rows only. Append new hand-triaged cases here.
_comment_winding: A differing winding multiset is NOT automatically a notation bug. Since the encoder canonicalizes winding on eta rings that can be turned over onto themselves (v0.3.6), any winding difference that survives is a real coordinated-face difference. QOFTOU_comp_0 is such a case: MetalloGen builds its ansa-bis(indenyl) zirconocene as rac or meso non-deterministically across runs, so the classifier's winding_flip pattern misroutes it to S4. It is a generator stereochemistry defect.
_comment_S6b_retriage: v0.4.2 S6b (roundtrip-atom-stereo) re-triaged its atom_stereo floor. KEBBUO_comp_0 removed from atom_stereo: R5 already resolved its spiro-siloxane Si @; it now fails only as a --quick 30s TimeoutException (timeout/no_conformers, S7 domain), so it auto-classifies there. SEMTOV_comp_0 and VEJXOZ_comp_0 are electron-deficient borane cages whose failures are a coordinated-face winding flip (B{n<} vs B{n}) plus boron-cage stereo the generator cannot reproduce -- routed to winding_flip (S5/geometry; docs records the borane residual), not sp3/heteroatom atom-stereo. JUCCUH_comp_0 is left as atom_stereo but is a documented residual: a trivalent [N@@H] that RDKit clears as amine inversion (Zone-A N known-deferred, see docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md).
_comment_R4_stale_removed: R4 (roundtrip-residual-tail) RE-MEASURED the previously-routed rows on branch 18198811 (origin/main c06495c + the R4 O/S charge fix), rdkit 2026.3.3, --quick FF, 2026-07-11, and REMOVED the routes that no longer fail: (a) the 5 H_on_terminal_oxo_imido rows FENMIX/KENTEE/KUNWIB/TIPCUR/ZIRPEX_comp_1 now round-trip byte-identical under R3's canonical comparator (success); (b) 11 of the 13 E/Z rows and 2 of the 13 @-rows (CILGEM, EJUBUH) now pass under R3, plus KAHZEB/KEDLUA. The 2 former E/Z rows ACOXOH (rmsd=1.09) and QEGJOE (rmsd=1.02) now fail only as borderline high_rmsd under FF -- a metrics/optimizer concern (S5), NOT an E/Z notation defect -- so they are LEFT UNROUTED to auto-classify as high_rmsd. See docs/agentic-notes/v0.3.7/roundtrip_residual_triage_R4.md.
_comment_R4_atom_stereo: The 11 @-rows below still fail as atom_stereo (sp3/@ and P stereocenter inversions from the embed) and are handed to the active R5/S6-stereo session (core/chirality.py + the generator embed stereo path). They are the string_mismatch_other rows whose per-fragment RDKit canonicalization differs only in @ tags.
